bounded_conclusions: One physical storage may be repartitioned between MODFLOW STO and an algebraically consistent dummy-side storage term without changing the solution.

The current positive +u/dt overlap probe is not equivalent to the consistent shared-storage partition for this transparent zero-resistance system.
MODFLOW Newton saturation smoothing is a separately identified numerical regularization and not the cause of the five-centimetre current-u discrepancy.
